title: Co-Producing AI: Toward an Augmented, Participatory Lifecycle
reasoning: The paper is centrally focused on AI ethics and responsible development. It proposes an augmented lifecycle that integrates ethical principles (fairness, accountability, transparency) and maps this lifecycle against major international ethical frameworks like the Montreal Declaration and the IEEE Global Initiative. Additionally, it discusses the cultural contingency of ethics, referencing non-Western honor systems and Indian art traditions to argue against a purely Western-centric approach to AI morality.
